items.evidence: My controller-built script on --board 3 cleared it (score 30, lives 3, 'clear'). At tick 606 the state was screen play, board 4, ball (-3, 1.248, 0), coins (-2,0.25,0), (2.2,1.2,0), (3.5,0.25,1.5), text 'Board 4 of 4'. --board 4 is accepted: tick 1 has ball (-3, 1.248, 0). The ramp is in the frame and is solid (see c02).

--board 4 '0:right': at x=-0.03 y=0.61, at x=0.54 y=0.80, at x=1.0 y=0.96, peak y 1.03 at x=1.4, y still 0.59 at x=3.0 (in flight). A ball pushed +z into the ramp's side slid along it at z of about -1.25 (max z -1.12 while |x|<1 and y<0.5). Rolling on the ramp it stays about 0.265 above the slope (no sinking).

'0:right' takes the air coin at tick 102 at ball (1.79, 1.01), still rising or falling clear of the ramp (score 10 to 20, 'coin'). '0:right,85:down,115:none' on --board 4 gives screen won, score 30. Board 3 then board 4 in one run gives won, score 60, and enter returns to the title.
texts on boards 1-4: en 'Board N of 4', es 'Tablero N de 4', fr 'Plateau N sur 4' (all twelve seen in the state). The board 4 frame in French shows 'PLATEAU 4 SUR 4'.

In Settings, menu_right on Language goes en, es, fr, en and menu_left goes back. With fr the texts are: title Commencer/Réglages/Quitter, settings, play 'Score : 0'/'Vies : 3', paused Pause/Reprendre/Quitter vers le titre, won 'Vous avez gagné', lost 'Partie terminée', plus hints. None in English or Spanish ('Roll' is the name, 'Score'/'Volume' are French words). language is fr. The frames agree.

Settings items: Volume, Language, Ball, Back ('Ball: Normal' at first). menu_left gives light (stops there), menu_right gives normal then heavy (stops there). ball_kind follows. Shown as Bola Ligera/Normal/Pesada and Balle Légère/Normale/Lourde.

--board 2 '0:right' with light/normal/heavy settings: ball x identical (-0.489271) at the tick before the first crate moves (tick 67). Sum of crate displacements 120 ticks later: light 2.75, normal 5.64, heavy 11.06.

A menu script set volume 7 and ball heavy. settings.json held all three, and a second run with that folder started at 7, en, heavy. An old-format settings.json without ball_kind ({volume 8, language fr}) loads with ball_kind normal.
Every old item that passed before still passes (m01-m12, m14-m24, below). m13 failed before and is not held against it.

The frame of --board 4 '0:right' at 90 ticks is an 800x480 PNG. It shows the slab, the ramp as a tilted tan slab with its thickness visible at the raised end, the ball on the ramp with its shadow, and the two coins not yet taken.
CHANGES.md lists each change with its files and functions, a pre-existing bug it fixed (sleeping crates), what was checked with which commands, and its limits.

defects: Board 2: after the ball strikes the wall, the upper crates sink into the lower ones and stay there. In all three ball weights, pairs of crates end with centres 0.01-0.10 apart (cubes are 0.5), so the frame shows 3 boxes for 6 crates. This likely followed the builder's crate-wake change, since the crates now really move.
README file table still says sim.py holds 'texts in both languages' and font.py has 'accents for Spanish'; the game now has three languages.
The flying coin (2.2, 1.2, 0) is taken with the ball at (1.79, 1.01), 0.45 away, before the ball reaches the coin's x.
could_not_check: m13: failed before the change and not held against it, so I did not test crate removal again.
